title: Quantum eMotion Completes Acquisition of Plurilock Security
html:
Insider Brief

  • Quantum eMotion has completed its acquisition of Plurilock Security, adding the Canadian cybersecurity company’s customer base, workforce and public- and private-sector relationships to its business.
  • Under the arrangement, Plurilock shareholders receive C$0.084 in cash and 0.0763 Quantum eMotion shares for each Plurilock share held.
  • The acquisition received 99.58% shareholder support, with Plurilock shares expected to be delisted from the TSX Venture Exchange on or around November 26, 2026.

PRESS RELEASE — Quantum eMotion Corp. (NYSE American: QNC) (TSXV: QNC) (FSE: 34Q0) (“QeM”) and Plurilock Security Inc. (TSXV: PLUR | OTCQB: PLCKF) (“Plurilock”) are pleased to announce the completion of their previously announced plan of arrangement (the “Arrangement”), pursuant to which QeM acquired all of the issued and outstanding common shares of Plurilock (each, a “Plurilock Share” and, collectively, the “Plurilock Shares”). The Arrangement was completed pursuant to the terms and conditions of the arrangement agreement between Plurilock and QeM dated September 28, 2026 (the “Arrangement Agreement”).

“Today marks a defining moment for Quantum eMotion,” said Francis Bellido, Chief Executive Officer of Quantum eMotion. “With the arrangement complete, our quantum-secure technologies now sit alongside Plurilock’s experienced team, long operating history and trusted relationships with hundreds of public- and private-sector customers in Canada, the United States and NATO. We’re grateful to Plurilock’s shareholders for their overwhelming support, and we warmly welcome Plurilock’s employees, customers and partners to the QeM family. Together, we’re in a strong position to bring AI- and quantum-secure cybersecurity to the organizations that need it most, and we’re excited to get to work.”

“On behalf of the board, I want recognize the team for building a Canadian cybersecurity company that governments and businesses have come to rely on, and thank our shareholders for their support towards this next chapter.” said Ali Hakimzadeh, Executive Chairman of Plurilock.

“We’re thrilled to begin this next chapter as part of Quantum eMotion,” said Ian L. Paterson, Chief Executive Officer of Plurilock. “Our customers will continue to get the same service and expertise they count on, now backed by quantum-secure innovation that keeps them ahead of tomorrow’s threats. Thank you to our shareholders, employees and partners for helping us reach this milestone.”

Under the Arrangement, holders of Plurilock Shares (“Shareholders”) became entitled to receive C$0.084 in cash and 0.0763 of a common share of QeM (each whole common share of QeM, a “QeM Share”) in exchange for each Plurilock Share held (together, the “Consideration”). All outstanding options to acquire Plurilock Shares (“Plurilock Options”) were cancelled in exchange for QeM Shares and cash in the same proportions as the Consideration having a value equal to the amount (if any) by which C$0.28 exceeded the applicable exercise price per Plurilock Option. All outstanding restricted share units vested immediately prior to the effective time of the Arrangement and were settled for the Consideration. All convertible debentures of Plurilock were repaid in cash at closing in accordance with their terms. All outstanding warrants of Plurilock, in accordance with their terms and without further action by the holders thereof, now entitle the holders to receive, upon exercise, the Consideration in lieu of Plurilock Shares.

As previously announced, the Arrangement was approved by Shareholders at the special meeting held on November 18, 2026, with 99.58% of the votes cast in favour of the special resolution approving the Arrangement (99.54% after excluding Plurilock Shares required to be excluded under Multilateral Instrument 61-101 – Protection of Minority Security Holders in Special Transactions).

The Supreme Court of British Columbia issued the final order approving the Arrangement on November 20, 2026.

Registered Shareholders are reminded that they must properly complete, sign and return the letter of transmittal, together with the certificate(s) representing their Plurilock Shares, as applicable, to Computershare Investor Services Inc., as depositary, in accordance with the instructions in the letter of transmittal, in order to receive the Consideration to which they are entitled under the Arrangement. Non-registered Shareholders should follow the instructions provided by their broker or other intermediary to receive their Consideration.

Following completion of the Arrangement, the Plurilock Shares are expected to be delisted from the TSX Venture Exchange (the “TSXV”) at the close of business on or about November 26, 2026. Plurilock intends to apply to the applicable securities regulators in Canada to cease to be a reporting issuer.

MENTIONED IN THE ARTICLE

Quantum eMotion is a Montreal based cybersecurity firm founded in 2007 that revolutionizes aerospace and defense by safeguarding connected vehicles and satellites against Q-Day and sophisticated cyber threats. The company provides quantum random number generator technology crucial for fortifying avionics systems, defense networks, and secure aerospace communications.
